translation.question: Welches spezifische Merkmal der seismischen Ruptur trug zu den starken Erschütterungen bei, die während des Einsturzes des Gebäudes des thailändischen Rechnungshofes in Bangkok zu spüren waren?
translation.translation_note: Translated 'supershear' as 'Supershear' since it is the established technical term in German seismology. 'State Audit Office' is translated as 'Rechnungshof'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which specific feature of the seismic rupture contributed to the strong shaking that was felt during the collapse of the building of the Thai Court of Audit in Bangkok?
backtranslation_en.expected_answer: Supershear nature of the seismic rupture
